name: Acid Fog
description: Acid fog creates a thick, clinging, greenish cloud. Creatures entering the cloud take 4d6 acid damage. Applies a 75% movement speed penalty with no save and -2 to AB and damage rolls for all creatures within the area of effect. Every round a creature spends in the cloud, it suffers 2d6 acid damage.

name: Aid
description: The target gains a +1 bonus to attack rolls, a +1 bonus on saving throws versus fear, and a 1d8 bonus to maximum hit points.

name: Animate Dead
description: Animate dead summons forth an undead minion. The type of undead summoned is dependent upon the [[Summoning_Changes#Undead_Summoning|undead caster level]].

name: Barkskin
description: Barkskin hardens the target creature's skin, granting a natural armor bonus to AC based on the caster's level: 1-6 +3, 7-12 +4, 13+ 5.

name: Bestow Curse
description: Applies one of the curses.<br>Curse Of Fatigue - Saving throw Fort: -4 physical ability drain.<br>Curse Of Kesefehon - Saving throw Fort: -10 to saving throws against disease.<br>Curse Of Hexxat Saving throw Fort: -6 to saving throws against poison.<br>Curse Of Slumber Saving throw Will: Sleep.<br>Curse Of Obedience Saving throw Will: -10 for Appraise, Intimidation, and Leadership. Automatic failure to resist Command spell.<br>Curse Of Paranoia Saving throw Will: -6 to saving throws against fear.<br>Curse Of Doubt - Saving throw Will: -2 AB, AC, Prevents Good Hope Spell bonus.<br>Curse Of Weave Eater Saving throw Will: 30% chance to receive d4(Spell Level) magic damage while casting any spell.

name: Blade Barrier
description: Blade barrier brings into being a 30-foot long and 3-foot wide wall of stabbing blades. All those passing through the wall take 1d6 points of slashing damage per caster level. Persistent area spells do not stack with themselves. When the same spell is cast it will be replaced and refreshed. Different area spells may be stacked. Same spell by different caster stacks. The same spell may be cast away from 50% of the center of the Area of Effect (AoE) radius, allowing a section where they can overlap, and hit twice.

name: Bless
description: All allies within the area of effect gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls, along with a +1 bonus on will saves against fear.

name: Blindness and Deafness
description: The target creature is struck blind and deaf.

name: Bulls Strength
description: The target creature's strength is increased by 1d4 + 1. The bonus stacks across multiple castings to a maximum of +5 when cast without metamagic feats. The stacking bonus is the same between the single and mass-targeted versions, but both spells can stack towards the maximum.

name: Burning Hands
description: A cone of fire shoots forth from the caster's hands, burning all hostiles and fixtures within its area of effect for 1d6 fire damage per caster level, up to a maximum of 10d6.

name: Call Lightning
description: All enemies within the area of effect take 1d6 points of electrical damage per caster level, to a maximum of 10d6. Damage dice are upgraded from d6s to d10s when the spell is cast outside during rain or thunder.

name: Chain Lightning
description: A bolt of electricity arcs through the caster's enemies for 1d6 points of electrical damage per caster level, up to a max of 20d6 points of damage to the initial target and half that amount to all other targets.

name: Charm Monster
description: In the eyes of the target creature, the personal reputation of the caster is improved by 50%.

name: Charm Person
description: In the eyes of the target humanoid, the personal reputation of the caster is improved by 50%.

name: Charm Person or Animal
description: In the eyes of the target animal or humanoid, the personal reputation of the caster is improved by 50%.

name: Circle of Death
description: A wave of negative energy bursts from the target location. Deal 8d6 negative damage on a failed save. Slays (Caster Level)d4 HD worth of creatures with HD less than or equal to the casting Character's level. Caster Level is capped at CL20 (20d4) for non-Palemasters and CL30 (30d4) for Palemasters and Wizard: Necromancer Specialists.

name: Circle of Doom
description: All enemies within the area of effect are struck with negative energy that causes 1d8 points of negative energy damage, +1 point per caster level. Negative energy spells have a reverse effect on undead, healing them instead of harming them.

name: Clairaudience and Clairvoyance
description: For the duration of the spell, the target creature gains a +10 bonus to all listen and spot checks. Spot bonus does not count towards piercing [[Disguise|disguises]].

name: Clarity
description: This spell removes the effects of daze, sleep, confusion, stun, and charm, and protects against all mind-affecting effects until it expires. For every effect removed by the spell, the target creature sustains 1 point of negative energy damage. Has 12 rounds of cooldown. The CD starts the moment the target is affected by the spell, not during casting.

name: Cloudkill
description: A billowing cloud of noxious vapors settles over the area. Its effects vary according to the hit dice of the affected creatures: 1-3 instant death, 4-6 fortitude save or death, 7+ 1d10 poison damage/round. Deals 1d4+1 CON damage per round to all creatures in the area of effect (fortitude save for half). Does not damage corpses. Persistent area spells do not stack with themselves. When the same spell is cast it will be replaced and refreshed. Different area spells may be stacked. Same spell by different caster stacks. The same spell may be cast away from 50% of the center of the Area of Effect (AoE) radius, allowing a section where they can overlap, and hit twice.

name: Color Spray
description: Color spray sends forth a dazzling array of lights to confound all creatures within the area of effect. Its effects vary according to the hit dice of the affected creatures: 1-2 sleep for 3 + 1d4 rounds, 3-4 blinded for 2 + 1d4 rounds, 5+ stunned for 1 + 1d4 rounds.

name: Cone of Cold
description: A cone of frost and snow shoots forth from the caster's hands, doing 1d6 points of cold damage per caster level to all hostiles and fixtures within the area of effect, to a maximum of 15d6.

name: Confusion
description: Affected creatures either wander randomly, attack a random target, or simply stand still.

name: Contagion
description: The target creature is struck down with one of the following debilitating diseases, randomly chosen: blinding sickness, cackle fever, mindfire, red ache, shakes, or slimy doom.

name: Control Undead
description: A single undead creature with up to 2 hit dice per caster level falls under the caster's control unless it makes a successful will save.

name: Create Greater Undead
description: The caster brings a powerful undead creature into being. The type of undead summoned is dependent upon the [[Summoning_Changes#Undead_Summoning|undead caster level]].

name: Create Undead
description: The caster brings an undead creature into being. The type of undead summoned is dependent upon the [[Summoning_Changes#Undead_Summoning|undead caster level]].

name: Cure Critical Wounds
description: The target creature is healed for 8d8 points of damage, +1 / character level of the target; no maximum. Healing spells have a reverse effect on undead, harming instead of healing them. A successful touch attack must first be made when this spell is used against undead.

name: Cure Light Wounds
description: The target creature is healed for 2d8 points of damage, +1 / character level of the target; no maximum. Healing spells have a reverse effect on undead, harming instead of healing them. A successful touch attack must first be made when this spell is used against undead.

name: Cure Minor Wounds
description: For every 3 caster levels, the target creature is healed by 1d3 points of damage (minimum 4). Healing spells have a reverse effect on undead, harming instead of healing them. The minimum damage against undead is 1, and a successful touch attack must first be made when this spell is used against undead. Damage versus Undead increased to 1d6 per 3 caster levels.

name: Cure Moderate Wounds
description: The target creature is healed for 4d8 points of damage, +1 / character level of the target; no maximum. Healing spells have a reverse effect on undead, harming instead of healing them. A successful touch attack must first be made when this spell is used against undead.

name: Cure Serious Wounds
description: The target creature is healed for 6d8 points of damage, +1 / character level of the target; no maximum. Healing spells have a reverse effect on undead, harming instead of healing them. A successful touch attack must first be made when this spell is used against undead.

name: Darkness
description: All creatures within the area of effect are shrouded in a haze of darkness which can only be pierced using [[Ultravision]]. Removes [[Faerie Fire]] effects for targets entering the Area of Effect. Protects light-sensitive characters when boarding other ships and protects from and restores sunlight penalties to light-sensitive races.

name: Daze
description: This spell inflicts 1d4 psychic damage for every 3 caster levels to the target. If the target is a humanoid creature with less Hit Dice than the caster level and fails their will saving throw, they are also dazed for 1d2 rounds.

name: Death Ward
description: The target creature becomes immune to any death spells, spell-like abilities, and effects.

name: Delayed Blast Fireball
description: The caster creates a small, magical zone that can detect the passage of enemy creatures. When the field is activated, it explodes, doing 1d6 points of fire damage per caster level to all within the area of effect, to a maximum of 20d6.

name: Dismissal
description: The caster targets a colossal radius and attempts to unsummon all summoned creatures therein upon failing a saving throw. All summoned creatures are affected, including undead, familiars and animal companions - henchmen are not affected. This has no effect on non-summoned creatures. A number of creatures equal to twice the caster's level in HD can be banished. Blocks all summoning spells in the area where cast for 30 seconds; excluding animating undead creatures.

name: Dispel Magic
description: This spell attempts to strip all magical effects from a single target. It can also target a group of creatures, attempting to remove the two most powerful spell effect from each creature. To remove an effect, the caster makes a [[Dispel Tables|dispel]] check up to +10 dispel caster level.

name: Divine Power
description: The caster gains the following bonuses: 1 extra hit point per caster level, strength is raised to 18 (if their strength is already 18 or higher, it is not raised further), and base attack bonus improves to that of a fighter of the same level. Cannot be cast from a scroll.

name: Dominate Animal
description: The target animal temporarily becomes a faithful and loyal servant of the caster.

name: Dominate Monster
description: The target monster temporarily becomes a faithful and loyal servant of the caster.

name: Dominate Person
description: The target person temporarily becomes a faithful and loyal servant of the caster.

name: Doom
description: The target creature receives a -2 modifier to all attack rolls, magical damage, saving throws and skill checks.

name: Flame Shield
description: The caster is surrounded by a ring of fire that damages all opponents who make a successful melee attack on the caster. The damage inflicted is 1d6 fire, +1 point per caster level. The caster also gains 50% immunity to cold and fire. Damage shield spells (aka biteback) that cause damage to a melee attacker do not stack. The last spell cast overrides any other damage shield. All damage shield spells are moved to the top of the [[Breach List]]. One exception: these spells '''do''' stack with the damage shield of the [[Aura Versus Alignment]] spell.

name: Elemental Swarm

classes.domain: Air Domain, Earth Domain, Fire Domain, Ooze Domain, Water Domain

description: The caster summons four elementals at the same time to act as loyal servants until they die or until the spell expires. They type of elemental is dependant on which spell book the spell is cast from.

name: Bears Endurance
description: The target creature's constitution is increased by 1d4 + 1. The bonus stacks across multiple castings to a maximum of +5 when cast without metamagic feats. The stacking bonus is the same between the single and mass-targeted versions, but both spells can stack towards the maximum.

name: Endure Elements
description: The target creature gains damage resistance 10/- against all elemental forms of damage. The spell ends after absorbing 30 points of damage from any single elemental type.

name: Energy Drain
description: The target creature permanently loses 2d4 character levels, until healed with greater restorative magic.

name: Enervation
description: The target creature temporarily loses 1d4 character levels.

name: Entangle
description: A mass of clinging vegetation wraps around all creatures in the area of effect. Those who fail the same are immobilized, flatfooted, receive a -2 penalty on all attack rolls and sets their dexterity to 3; though still able to fight and cast spells, but must make a concentration check (DC 15) or the attempt will fail. All those affected, even those who make a reflex save, have their movement reduced by half. Persistent area spells do not stack with themselves. When the same spell is cast it will be replaced and refreshed. Different area spells may be stacked. Same spell by different caster stacks. The same spell may be cast away from 50% of the center of the Area of Effect (AoE) radius, allowing a section where they can overlap, and hit twice.

name: Fear
description: Affected creatures are consumed with mind-numbing fear that overrides all other actions. The affected creatures run away from all those they do not consider allies.

name: Feeblemind
description: The caster does 1d4 points of intelligence damage to the creature for every 4 caster levels. Applies charisma damage as well. If the target has arcane caster levels, the DC is increased by 4. If the intelligence would drop below 3, the target is stunned instead for 1 round/level. Metamagic functions normally. NOTE: Will only use the base attribute, without item bonuses, when checking for Stun effect.

name: Finger of Death
description: The target creature must make a fortitude save or die. If they succeed, they still take 3d6 points of damage, +1 point per caster level.

name: Fire Storm
description: All enemies within this spell's area of effect are inundated with a rain of fire and take 1d6 points of damage per caster level. Half of the damage is divine and the other half is fire-based.

name: Fireball
description: The caster unleashes a fiery projectile that explodes upon all within the area of effect for 1d6 points of fire damage per caster level, to a maximum of 15d6.

name: Flame Arrow
description: The caster launches 1 conjured fiery arrow at the target creature for every 4 caster levels. Each arrow does 4d6 points of fire damage.

name: Flame Lash
description: The druid is able to flay an enemy with flaming brands that do 2d6 points of fire damage, + 1d6 per 2 caster levels above level 4.

name: Flame Strike
description: A pillar of flame engulfs all within the area of effect, inflicting 1d6 points of damage per caster level (to a maximum of 15d6). Half of the damage caused by the spell is divine and the other half is fire-based. Enemies are struck by both damage types, while allies are struck only by the fire damage.

name: Freedom of Movement
description: The target creature becomes immune to paralysis, slow, and entanglement spells and effects. Is breachable as part of the [[Breach List]].

name: Gate
description: This powerful summoning spell opens a portal to another plane. The type of summon is dependent upon the specific summon [[Summoning_Changes#Summoning_Streams|stream]]. Conjuring a summon that is different from the caster's alignment is subject to [[Summoning_Changes#Alignment_divergence|alignment divergence]] and losing control of the summon. One can see the chance of hostility using the [[Console_command#-stream|-stream]] command, use [[Console_command#-stream|-stream ?]] for more details.

name: Globe of Invulnerability
description: A shimmering field of energy prevents all spells of level 4 or lower from affecting the caster.

name: Grease
description: A churning field of oil and grease fills the target area, causing all within to either fall down or move at a reduced speed. Persistent area spells do not stack with themselves. When the same spell is cast it will be replaced and refreshed. Different area spells may be stacked. Same spell by different caster stacks. The same spell may be cast away from 50% of the center of the Area of Effect (AoE) radius, allowing a section where they can overlap, and hit twice.

name: Greater Dispelling
description: Greater dispelling attempts to strip all magical effects from a single target. It can also target a group of creatures, attempting to remove the two most powerful spell effect from each creature. To remove an effect, the caster makes a [[Dispel Tables|dispel]] check up to +23 dispel caster level.

name: Greater Magic Weapon
description: You empower the touched weapon with a +1 enhancement bonus per caster levels +3 divided by 4 (maximum of +5). You can either directly target the weapon you want to cast this spell on, or you can target a creature, affecting the creature's main hand weapon. Restricted weapon enchantment.

name: Greater Planar Binding
description: This spell has two modes of operation: targeting a single outsider, or summoning a planar ally. Targeted outsiders are paralyzed for 1 round per 2 caster levels. The type of summoned ally is based on the the specific summon [[Summoning_Changes#Summoning_Streams|stream]]. Conjuring a summon that is different from the caster's alignment is subject to [[Summoning_Changes#Alignment_divergence|alignment divergence]] and losing control of the summon. One can see the chance of hostility using the [[Console_command#-stream|-stream]] command, use [[Console_command#-stream|-stream ?]] for more details.

name: Greater Restoration
description: Greater restoration removes most temporary and all permanent negative effects from the target character, including level drain. It does not remove negative mental effects or the effects of reduced movement speed. It also heals the target creature to full hit points. Set the thirst, hunger and rest values of the target to 0% if the existing value was lower. Has 240 seconds of cooldown timer before it can be casted again. Also removes the [[Nightmare]] curse and the associated effects.

name: Shadow Evocation
description: The caster taps energy from the Plane of Shadow to cast a quasi-real, illusory version of a the following: Shadowbolt, Wall of Fire, Flame Shield (Elemental Shield) (9), Gust of Wind. Shadowbolt: A line of crackling, bolts erupt from your fingertips. Any creature struck by a shadowbolt takes 1d8 damage per caster level (maximum 10d8), split evenly between electricity and negative energy damage. Will save for half. All spells are be considered Illusion and use Illusion focus for calculating the DC.

name: Greater Spell Breach
description: This spell strips the target creature of up to four magical defenses according to the [[Breach List]]. This spell will also reduce the target creature's SR by 5 for ten rounds.

name: Greater Spell Mantle
description: Creates a barrier around the caster that absorbs all incoming spells. It can absorb up to 4d6 + 1/6 CL levels of spells before collapsing.

name: Greater Stoneskin
description: Grants the caster a damage reduction of 20/+5. The spell absorbs 10 points of melee damage per caster level, to a maximum of 150, before fading.

name: Gust of Wind
description: This spell creates a blast of air that knocks down any creatures failing their saving throws. It is also powerful enough to disperse any cloudlike area of effect spells (such as [[Cloudkill]]) that are in the path of the wind gust.

name: Hammer of the Gods
description: The caster smites a group of enemies with divine light for 1d8 points of damage for every two caster levels, to a maximum of 10d8. Enemies that make a will save take half damage and avoid being dazed for 1 to 6 rounds.

name: Harm
description: Deals 10 * CL points of damage. Will not reduce health below 1 HP. Damage can not longer exceed a target's current health, regardless of existing Damage Vulnerabilities. The effect of Damage Immunities is unchanged.

name: Haste
description: The target of this spell is hasted, gaining +4 bonus to dodge armor class, 1 extra action per round (allowing an additional attack or spell to be cast), and has their movement increased by 50%.

name: Heal
description: Heals 100 + 5*CL. Capped at 200 at level 20. Healing spells have a reverse effect when used on undead, harming instead of healing them (undead are reduced to 1d4 hit points with this spell). A successful touch attack must first be made when this spell is used against undead.

name: Healing Circle
description: When cast, a stationary zone is placed below the caster that heals all creatures within the area of effect each round for a period of three rounds. All friendly creatures within the area of effect are healed for 1d8 hit points, +1 points per caster level. Healing spells have a reverse effect when used on undead, harming instead of healing them.

name: Hold Animal
description: The target animal is paralyzed for the duration of the spell.

name: Hold Monster
description: The target monster is paralyzed for the duration of the spell.

name: Hold Person
description: The target humanoid is paralyzed for the duration of the spell.

name: Holy Sword
description: This spell transforms the caster's melee weapon into a powerful holy avenger, a specially blessed weapon that, when wielded by paladin, acts like a +5 holy weapon that dispels magic on-hit and grants the wielder a spell resistance of 16. Self target only. The On-Hit Dispel effect is capped at caster level 21. If the caster has Abjuration Foci, the Dispel check improves by +1 per focus feat. Holy sword can only trigger once per flurry (ie. 2 second cooldown) and has a 1 round cooldown after successfully removing 1+ effects from a target. Can no longer be crafted into wands or scrolls. Non-restricted weapon enchantment.

name: Identify
description: Over the next two rounds, the caster gains a bonus of 10 +1 per caster level to their lore skill.

name: Implosion
description: The caster creates a vortex of destruction that tears asunder all living things within its area of effect, killing them instantly unless they make their saving throw. There is no additional +3 bonus to the difficulty check. Implosion ignores targets who are in [[Ethereal Visage]], [[Greater Sanctuary]] or [[Sanctuary]].

name: Improved Invisibility
duration: Invisibility 1 round / level, Concealment 1 turn / level
description: The target creature becomes invisible and impossible to detect using normal vision. The invisibility effect last rounds/level. [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Illusion|Greater Spell Focus: Illusion]] increases the duration from 1 round/level to 3 rounds/level. [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Illusion|Epic Spell Focus: Illusion]] increases it to 5 rounds/level. The concealment on Improved Invisibility remains unaltered at 1 turn / level. After attacking or casting spells the target creature will become partially visible and detectable by enemies, but still retain the 50% concealment bonus. Removes the Faerie Fire effect on the target it is cast upon.

name: Incendiary Cloud
description: The caster creates a cloud of smoke and embers that causes 4d6 + 1d6 per 2 levels points of fire damage each round to all creatures within the area of effect. Creatures within the area of effect are blinded (no save). Does not damage corpses. Persistent area spells do not stack with themselves. When the same spell is cast it will be replaced and refreshed. Different area spells may be stacked. Same spell by different caster stacks. The same spell may be cast away from 50% of the center of the Area of Effect (AoE) radius, allowing a section where they can overlap, and hit twice.

name: Invisibility
description: The target creature becomes invisible and impossible to detect using normal vision. Any attack or spellcasting action taken by the invisible creature will immediately cancel the invisibility. The invisibility effect last rounds/level. [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Illusion|Greater Spell Focus: Illusion]] increases the duration from 1 round/level to 3 rounds/level. [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Illusion|Epic Spell Focus: Illusion]] increases it to 5 rounds/level.

name: Invisibility Purge
description: This spell removes the invisibility from all invisible creatures and items. Includes removing concealment from [[Improved Invisibility]]. The aura around the caster is visible. There is a visual cue if the spell removed invisibility from a creature. Targets within the aura are not affected by invisibility spells.

name: Invisibility Sphere
description: The caster brings into being a zone of invisibility that travels with him for the duration of the spell. All allies within the spell's area of effect are rendered invisible, but not to each other. Those that leave the sphere are visible once more. The invisibility effect lasts rounds/level. [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Illusion|Greater Spell Focus: Illusion]] increases the duration from 1 round/level to 3 rounds/level. [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Illusion|Epic Spell Focus: Illusion]] increases it to 5 rounds/level.

name: Knock
description: This spell will unlock containers sealed by conventional locks in a 150ft radius around the caster. Exceptionally complex locking mechanisms and containers are beyond the abilities of this spell. Will not open containers with a DC above 40 (This currently still allows it to open all existing loot chests except for Runic chests).

name: Lesser Dispel
description: This spell attempts to strip all magical effects from a single target. It can also target a group of creatures, attempting to remove the two most powerful spell effect from each creature. To remove an effect, the caster makes a [[Dispel Tables|dispel]] check up to +5 dispel caster level.

name: Lesser Mind Blank

classes.domain: Magic Domain, Moon Domain, Mind Domain

description: This spell renders the target creature immune to mind-affecting spells and spell-like effects, and removes all negative effects caused by such spells.

name: Lesser Planar Binding

classes.domain: Evil Domain, Good Domain, Law Domain

description: This spell has two modes of operation: targeting a single outsider, or summoning a planar ally. Targeted outsiders are paralyzed for 1 round per 2 caster levels. The type of summoned ally is based on the the specific summon [[Summoning_Changes#Summoning_Streams|stream]]. Conjuring a summon that is different from the caster's alignment is subject to [[Summoning_Changes#Alignment_divergence|alignment divergence]] and losing control of the summon. One can see the chance of hostility using the [[Console_command#-stream|-stream]] command, use [[Console_command#-stream|-stream ?]] for more details.

name: Lesser Restoration
description: Removes all magical, extraordinary, and supernatural effects that apply a penalty to ability scores, armor class, attack and damage rolls, spell resistance, and saving throws. This spell will not remove the effects of a curse or a disease. Will set the thirst, hunger and rest values of the target to 0% if the existing value was lower.

name: Lesser Spell Breach
description: This spell strips the target creature of up to two magical defenses according to the [[Breach List]]. This spell will also reduce the target creature's SR by 3 for ten rounds.

name: Lesser Spell Mantle
description: Creates a barrier around the caster that absorbs all incoming spells and spell-like abilities. It can absorb up to 1d6 + 1/6 CL (avg: 9.5, empowered: 11) levels of spells before collapsing.

name: Light
description: Creates a small light source above the target creature's head. The light travels with the target and is capable of illuminating a small area. It can be cast on any item the character can equip to make it glow for the spell's duration like a natural source of light. The color of the spell can be changed using the text command prior to casting: Green: -gre, White: -wht, Yellow: -yel, Orange: -ora, Red: -cri, Purple: -pur, Blue: -blu.

name: Lightning Bolt
description: The caster fires a bolt of lightning that passes through all creatures in a straight line from the caster. The bolt does 1d6 points of electrical damage per caster level, to a maximum of 15d6.

name: Mage Armor
description: The selected target gains the following bonuses to his AC: +1 natural armor, +1 dodge, +1 deflection, and +1 enhancement. The dodge bonus stacks with other dodge bonuses to AC, but the other bonuses do not stack with bonuses of the same type.

name: Magic Missile
description: The caster creates a shimmering projectile of magical force that unerringly slams into a single selected target. After level 1, the spell creates 1 additional missile every two caster levels, to a maximum of 5 missiles at level 9. Magic missiles do 1d4+1 points of force damage each.

name: Magic Vestment
description: You empower the touched armor or shield with a +1 AC bonus per 3 caster levels (maximum of +5). Casting this spell twice on your character will first apply the spell to your Armor and then your Shield (If you have one equipped).

name: Magic Weapon
description: You empower the touched weapon with a +1 enhancement bonus. Restricted weapon enchantment.

name: Mass Blindness and Deafness
description: All enemies within a 10-ft radius are struck blind and deaf.

name: Mass Charm
description: In the eyes of all non-allied humanoids within the area of effect, the personal reputation of the caster is improved by 50%. The caster can charm up to twice his caster level in creatures.

name: Mass Haste
description: All allies within the area of effect gain 1 extra action per round (allowing an additional attack or spell casting) and have their movement speed increased by 50%.

name: Mass Heal
description: All allies within the area of effect are healed 150 + 5*CL. Capped at 300 at level 30. Healing spells have a reverse effect on undead, harming instead of healing them (undead are reduced to 1d4 hit points with this spell).

name: Melfs Acid Arrow
description: The caster targets a single creature with an acid bolt. The initial damage from the spell is 3d6, +1d6 every round until the spell expires.<br><br>'''Note''': Elementalist (Earth) - Initial damage increased by 1d6 per 2 caster levels (caps at 12d6).

name: Meteor Swarm
description: The spell causes everything within the area of effect to be pummeled by incoming meteors. All those caught in the destruction take 30d8 points of fire damage, except for allies. All those within 2 meters of the caster are also protected from the spell's effect.

name: Mind Blank
description: This spell renders all allies within the area of effect immune to mind-affecting spells and effects. All negative mind-affecting effects are also removed from the target creatures.

name: Mind Fog
description: This spell creates a bank of blue fog that saps the will of all those who enter it. Victims take a 2d6 penalty (will save for half) on will saving throws against mind-affecting spells and effects and are dazed for 1 round (will save negates). This penalty persists for as long as the creature remains in the fog and for an additional 2d6 rounds upon leaving.

name: Minor Globe of Invulnerability
description: A shimmering field of energy prevents all spells of level 3 or lower from affecting the caster.

name: Ghostly Visage
description: The caster is surrounded by a ghostly nimbus of light that grants damage reduction 5/+1, prevents all spells of level 1 or lower from affecting the caster, and grants 10% concealment.

name: Ethereal Visage
description: The caster is surrounded by a ghostly nimbus of light that grants damage reduction 20/+3, prevents all spells of level 2 or lower from affecting the caster and provides a 25% concealment bonus.

name: Mordenkainens Disjunction
description: First, breaches a single enemy of up to 6 magical defenses or a group of enemies of 2 spell protections each according to the [[Breach List]]. Then, attempts to strip all magical effects from a single target in a dispel attempt. Or, if AoE targeted, attempting to remove the two most powerful spell effect from each creature. To remove an effect for the dispel portion, the caster makes a [[Dispel Tables|dispel]] check up to +23 dispel caster level.  Finally, the spell will lower the SR of all creatures within the area of effect by 10 for 10 rounds. Does not lower [[Monk]] spell resistance.

name: Mordenkainens Sword
description: The caster summons a powerful, sword-wielding helmed horror that acts as a faithful and loyal servant.

name: Natures Balance
description: All enemies within the area of effect have their spell resistance lowered by 1d4. All allies within the area of effect are healed for 3d8 hit points, +1 point per caster level. Also applies [[Lesser Spell Breach]] (2 spells are breached) effect to enemies caught in the AoE; the breach effect is saveless. With [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Transmutation|Greater Spell Focus: Transmutation]] 3 spells are breached and the AoE is increased. With [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Transmutation|Epic Spell Focus: Transmutation]] 3 spells are breached and the AoE is increased further.

name: Negative Energy Protection
description: The target creature is rendered immune to all negative energy attacks, including supernatural ability damage and level drains.

name: Neutralize Poison
description: A target creature has all traces of poison removed from their system.

name: Phantasmal Killer
description: The caster conjures an image of utmost horror to strike down a single creature. The target may attempt a will save to disbelieve the spell, avoiding all ill effects. Failing that, the target then makes a fortitude save to avoid instant death. A successful save still inflicts 3d6 points of psychic damage. Fears a target for 1 round / level on a failed will save. A target that fails their fortitude save still dies.

name: Planar Binding
description: This spell has two modes of operation: targeting a single outsider, or summoning a planar ally. Targeted outsiders are paralyzed for 1 round per 2 caster levels. The type of summoned ally is based upon the specific summon [[Summoning_Changes#Summoning_Streams|stream]]. Conjuring a summon that is different from the caster's alignment is subject to [[Summoning_Changes#Alignment_divergence|alignment divergence]] and losing control of the summon. One can see the chance of hostility using the [[Console_command#-stream|-stream]] command, use [[Console_command#-stream|-stream ?]] for more details.

name: Poison
description: The target must make a Fortitude save or suffer the effects of poison dealing 1d8 Constitution damage on primary state. If the poison is not treated within a minute the secondary state will hit the target and deal 6 + 4d12 poison damage and stun the target for 1d4 rounds.

name: Polymorph Self
description: The caster is able to turn himself into one of the following forms: giant spider, troll, umber hulk, pixie, zombie. The Umberhulk form no longer gets the [[True Seeing (spell)|True Seeing]] effect. Spell can no longer be cast while mounted. Grants a +10 bonus to Bluff/Perform.

name: Power Word Kill
description: This spell may be cast on a single creature or as an area effect. Targets with more than 100 of HP must pass a fortitude save or be slain. There is a +3 DC bonus (bonus for the caster) from 101 to 150 HP, +2 for 151 to 200, +1 for 201 to 250 and +0 250 and up.

name: Power Word Stun
description: Targets with more than 150 of HP must pass a will save or be stunned for a duration according to the HP. Additionally, there is a small bonus DC relevant to the HP. HP above 300: No bonus, 251 to 300: +1 DC, 201 to 250: +2 DC and duration changes to 4+1d4 rounds, 151 to 200: +3 DC and duration changes to 5+1d4 rounds, 101 to 150: Automatic success and duration changes to 6+2d4 rounds, less than 101: Automatic success and duration changes to 7+2d4 rounds.

name: Prayer
description: All allies within the area of effect gain +1 to attack and damage rolls, skill checks, and saving throws. Enemies receive -1 penalties to the same.

name: Premonition

classes.domain: Luck Domain, Knowledge Domain, Moon Domain

description: Allows the caster to see a few moments into the future. This grants him damage reduction 30/+5, and absorbs 10 points of melee damage per caster level before collapsing.

name: Prismatic Spray
description: All creatures within the area of effect randomly experience 1 or 2 of the following effects: 20 fire damage (reflex), 40 acid damage (reflex), 80 electrical damage (reflex), Struck with bebilith venom poison (fortitude), Paralyzed for 10 rounds (fortitude), Confused for 10 rounds (will vs. mind-affecting), or Struck dead (will vs. death magic).

name: Protection from Elements
description: The target creature gains damage resistance 30/- against all elemental forms of damage. The spell ends after absorbing 60 points of damage from any single elemental type.

name: Protection from Spells
description: Within the area of effect, up to one ally per 4 caster levels receives a +8 bonus on all saving throws against spells.

name: Raise Dead
description: Returns one target corpse to life. The raised character returns to life with only 1 hit point. Expensive to scribe, and casting (even from scrolls) costs 50% and 75% of [[Deity#Piety|Piety]], respectively. Insufficient piety will result in the spell being consumed and doing nothing. Characters with [[Cleric]] levels reduce the piety penalty by a flat 25%. If the spells are cast from a tome or a special item, there's no piety cost.

name: Ray of Enfeeblement
description: The target creature takes 1d6 strength damage, plus 1 per 2 caster levels, to a maximum of 11 damage.

name: Ray of Frost
description: Inflicts 1d6 cold damage for every 3 caster levels to a single target creature.

name: Remove Blindness and Deafness
description: All allies within the area of effect are cured of blindness and deafness.

name: Remove Curse
description: All standard curses and curse effects are removed from the target creature. Remove Curse can remove Greater curses as long as the caster wins the caster level check vs the caster level of the greater curse.

name: Remove Disease
description: All diseases and disease effects are removed from the target creature.

name: Remove Fear
description: All fear effects are removed from allies within the area of effect. The targets also gain a +4 bonus to saving throws against fear spells and effects for the duration of the spell.

name: Remove Paralysis
description: All paralysis and hold effects are removed from allies within the area of effect.

name: Resist Elements
description: The target creature gains damage resistance 20/- against all elemental forms of damage. The spell ends after absorbing 50 points of accumulated damage from any single elemental type.

name: Resistance
description: This spell grants the target creature damage reduction 1/+1, absorbing 1d6 points of physical damage + 1 point per caster level before collapsing. The damage reduction improves to 2/+2 at caster level 7, 3/+3 at caster level 14, 4/+4 at caster level 21 and 5/+5 at caster level 28.

name: Restoration
description: Removes all magical, extraordinary and supernatural effects that apply a penalty to ability scores, armor class, attack and damage rolls, spell resistance, saving throws and damage immunity. This spell also removes all ability drain, level drain, blindness and deafness effects. While this spell will not remove a curse or disease itself, it will remove (supernatural) ability score penalties caused by a disease. Will set the thirst, hunger and rest values of the target to 0% if the existing value was lower.

name: Resurrection
description: Returns a single target corpse to life with full hit points. Expensive to scribe, and casting (even from scrolls) costs 50% and 75% of [[Deity#Piety|Piety]], respectively. Insufficient piety will result in the spell being consumed and doing nothing. Characters with [[Cleric]] levels reduce the piety penalty by a flat 25%. If the spells are cast from a tome or a special item, there's no piety cost.

name: Sanctuary
description: The caster's or the person's, touched by the caster, presence is completely ignored by nearby creatures for the duration of the spell. Disabled temporarily. Existing scrolls and potions will not work.

name: Scare
description: A target creature with 5 hit dice or less is afflicted with fear and suffers a -2 morale check to attack, damage and saving rolls.

name: Searing Light
description: The caster directs a beam of white-hot light at a single target. The damage is based on the target's racial type: Undead: 1d8 per caster level, to a maximum of 10d8; Construct: 1d6 for every 2 caster levels, to a maximum of 5d6; or Other: 1d8 for per 2 caster levels, to a maximum of 5d8.

name: See Invisibility
description: The target creature is able to see all invisible creatures within his line of sight. Sight-augmenting spells will default to less obtrusive eyeglow effects rather than the floating eyes.

name: Greater Shadow Conjuration
description: Allows the caster to conjure a shadow variant of one of the following spells: [[Web|Web(?)]], [[Minor Globe of Invulnerability|Minor Globe of Invulnerability(11)]], [[Stoneskin|Stoneskin(10+)]], [[Summon Shadow|Summon Shadow(11)]], [[Flame Arrow|Flame Arrow(?)]]. All spells are be considered Illusion and use Illusion focus for calculating the DC. Summon Shadow summons 3 shadows and the summons duration is 1 round / caster level. Duration becomes turns per level with [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Illusion|Spell Focus: Illusion]], hours per level with [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Illusion|Greater Spell Focus: Illusion]], and hours * 2 per level with [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Illusion|Epic spell Focus: Illusion]]. The shadows also gain 10% more concealment per Illusion Focus feat.

name: Shadow Conjuration
description: Allows the caster to conjure a shadow variant of one of the following spells: [[Mage Armor|Mage Armor(7)]], [[Summon Shadow|Summon Shadow(7)]], [[Ghostly Visage|Ghostly Visage(7)]], [[Grease|Grease(?)]], [[Mestil's Acid Breath|Mestil's Acid Breath(?)]]. Shadow [[Mage Armor]] does not stack with normal version or itself. All spells are be considered Illusion and use Illusion focus for calculating the DC. Summon Shadow summons 3 shadows and the summons duration is 1 round / caster level. Duration becomes turns per level with [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Illusion|Spell Focus: Illusion]], hours per level with [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Illusion|Greater Spell Focus: Illusion]], and hours * 2 per level with [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Illusion|Epic spell Focus: Illusion]]. The shadows also gain 10% more concealment per Illusion Focus feat.

name: Shadow Shield
description: The caster is shrouded in a cloak of shadow that protects them with the following effects: +5 natural AC bonus, 10/+3 damage reduction, immunity to instant death effects, immunity to necromancy spells, and immunity to negative energy damage.

name: Shapechange
description: The caster is temporarily transformed into one of several fearsome creatures of destruction. Possible forms include: red dragon, fire giant, balor, death slaad, or iron golem. Can no longer be cast while mounted. Grants +10 Bluff/Perform.

name: Silence
description: Creates a zone of silence around the target creature, preventing all within the area of effect from casting spells with verbal components. If cast on an ally, no saving throws or spell resistance checks are necessary.

name: Slay Living
description: The target must make a fortitude save or die. Even if the saving throw is successful, the target takes 3d6 points of negative energy damage, +1 point per caster level.

name: Sleep
description: Causes caster level + 1d4 HD of creatures to fall into a comatose slumber, beginning with those with the fewest HD. Empower Spell increases affected hit dice by 50%. Creatures with hit dice less than the caster's class level are affected.

name: Slow
description: All enemy creatures within the area of effect are slowed, having their movement lowered by 50% and lose a single attack per round.

name: Sound Burst
description: All creatures within the area of effect take 1d8 points of damage and must make a will save or be stunned for 2 rounds.

name: Spell Resistance
description: The target creature has its spell resistance set to 12, +1 per caster level. If the target already had a higher spell resistance, this spell has no effect.

name: Spell Mantle
description: Creates a barrier around the caster that absorbs all incoming spells and spell-like abilities. It can absorb up to 2d6 + 1/6 CL spell levels before collapsing. Duration becomes 1 round / level when casting the spells via items.

name: Stinking Cloud
description: All creatures caught within the area of effect are dazed. These effects last as long as they remain within the cloud and for 1 round after they leave.

name: Stoneskin
description: This spell grants the target creature damage reduction 10/+5. The spell absorbs 10 points of melee damage per caster level, to a maximum of 100, before collapsing.

name: Storm of Vengeance
description: The area around the caster is blasted by lightning and acidic rain. Each round, all enemies within the area of effect take 3d6 points of acid damage. Those who fail a reflex save take an additional 6d6 points of electrical damage and are stunned for two rounds.

name: Summon Creature I
description: The caster summons a beast to be a faithful and loyal servant. The type of summon is thematically dependent upon the caster's surface or underdark origins, but is mechanically identical. The spell's tier can be increased with [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Conjuration|Greater Spell Focus: Conjuration]], [[Animal Domain]] or [[Vermin Domain]]. If the Greater Spell Focus and one of the Domains is present the creature is further strengthened by the Spell Focus Bonuses, which do not otherwise apply to the Summon Creature line of spells; the tier does not increase further.

name: Summon Creature II
description: The caster summons a beast to be a faithful and loyal servant. The type of summon is thematically dependent upon the caster's surface or underdark origins, but is mechanically identical. The spell's tier can be increased with [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Conjuration|Greater Spell Focus: Conjuration]], [[Animal Domain]] or [[Vermin Domain]]. If the Greater Spell Focus and one of the Domains is present the creature is further strengthened by the Spell Focus Bonuses, which do not otherwise apply to the Summon Creature line of spells; the tier does not increase further.

name: Summon Creature III
description: The caster summons a beast to be a faithful and loyal servant. The type of summon is thematically dependent upon the caster's surface or underdark origins, but is mechanically identical. The spell's tier can be increased with [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Conjuration|Greater Spell Focus: Conjuration]], [[Animal Domain]] or [[Vermin Domain]]. If the Greater Spell Focus and one of the Domains is present the creature is further strengthened by the Spell Focus Bonuses, which do not otherwise apply to the Summon Creature line of spells; the tier does not increase further.

name: Summon Creature IV
description: The caster summons a beast to be a faithful and loyal servant. The type of summon is thematically dependent upon the caster's surface or underdark origins, but is mechanically identical. The spell's tier can be increased with [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Conjuration|Greater Spell Focus: Conjuration]], [[Animal Domain]] or [[Vermin Domain]]. If the Greater Spell Focus and one of the Domains is present the creature is further strengthened by the Spell Focus Bonuses, which do not otherwise apply to the Summon Creature line of spells; the tier does not increase further.

name: Summon Creature IX
description: The caster summons an elder elemental to be a faithful and loyal servant. The type of summon is dependent upon the summon [[Summoning_Changes#Summoning_Streams|stream]], or is random if there is no stream. Use [[Console_command#-stream|-stream ?]] for more details. The spell's tier does not increase, but an ancient elemental is conjured with [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Conjuration|Greater Spell Focus: Conjuration]], [[Animal Domain]] or [[Vermin Domain]]. If the Greater Spell Focus and one of the Domains is present the elemental is further strengthened by the Spell Focus Bonuses, which do not otherwise apply to the Summon Creature line of spells; the tier does not increase further. The elemental's power also increases with [[Summoning_Changes#Epic_Caster_Bonus|Epic Caster Bonuses]].

name: Summon Creature V
description: The caster summons a beast to be a faithful and loyal servant. The type of summon is thematically dependent upon the caster's surface or underdark origins, but is mechanically identical. The spell's tier can be increased with [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Conjuration|Greater Spell Focus: Conjuration]], [[Animal Domain]] or [[Vermin Domain]]. If the Greater Spell Focus and one of the Domains is present the creature is further strengthened by the Spell Focus Bonuses, which do not otherwise apply to the Summon Creature line of spells; the tier does not increase further.
