description: The caster summons a beast to be a faithful and loyal servant. The type of summon is thematically dependent upon the caster's surface or underdark origins, but is mechanically identical. The spell's tier can be increased with [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Conjuration|Greater Spell Focus: Conjuration]], [[Animal Domain]] or [[Vermin Domain]]. If the Greater Spell Focus and one of the Domains is present the creature is further strengthened by the Spell Focus Bonuses, which do not otherwise apply to the Summon Creature line of spells; the tier does not increase further.

name: Summon Creature VII
description: The caster summons a huge elemental to be a faithful and loyal servant. The type of summon is dependent upon the summon [[Summoning_Changes#Summoning_Streams|stream]], or is random if there is no stream. Use [[Console_command#-stream|-stream ?]] for more details. The spell's tier can be increased with [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Conjuration|Greater Spell Focus: Conjuration]], [[Animal Domain]] or [[Vermin Domain]]. If the Greater Spell Focus and one of the Domains is present the elemental is further strengthened by the Spell Focus Bonuses, which do not otherwise apply to the Summon Creature line of spells; the tier does not increase further.

name: Summon Creature VIII
description: The caster summons a greater elemental to be a faithful and loyal servant. The type of summon is dependent upon the summon [[Summoning_Changes#Summoning_Streams|stream]], or is random if there is no stream. Use [[Console_command#-stream|-stream ?]] for more details. The spell's tier can be increased with [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Conjuration|Greater Spell Focus: Conjuration]], [[Animal Domain]] or [[Vermin Domain]]. If the Greater Spell Focus and one of the Domains is present the elemental is further strengthened by the Spell Focus Bonuses, which do not otherwise apply to the Summon Creature line of spells; the tier does not increase further.

name: Sunbeam
description: The caster summons a globe of divine radiance to blind and burn those within the area of effect. Undead take 1d6 points of divine damage per caster level, to a maximum of 10d6. All other monster types take 3d6 points of divine damage, and are blinded for 3 rounds. A successful reflex save halves the damage for undead and voids blindness for others. Inflict sunlight penalties to light sensitive races. The duration is 4 rounds, 2 with a successful reflex save (Vampire PC's will only be affected for a maximum of 3 rounds). This effect ignores spell resistance and will affect everyone in the area of effect, including the caster. Friendly creatures are always treated as if they'd passed the save. Darkness spells protect and restore the affected targets.

name: Tensers Transformation
description: Requires 80% of Class levels to be Wizard to be able to cast; Spellsword counts as Wizard levels for this requirement. No longer polymorphs caster, allows usage of original equipment/items. Divine Shield will fail if cast during this spell's duration, Tenser's will fail if Divine Shield is active. Acts as Divine Power for increasing BAB (and extra attacks). Gains +1 to Strength and Dexterity for each Transmutation Spell Focus. Gains +5 bonus to Fortitude. Gains (Wizard Level)d6 bonus to HP. 100% Arcane Spell Failure. Command "-dispel ten" removes spell effects. Also prevents Spellswords from using Elemental Strike. Additional interactions for Transmutation Specialist Wizards.

name: Time Stop
description: The caster is able to defy the sands of time, casting spells, moving about, and attacking normally while the rest of the world appears suspended, as if in stasis. Only affects the area in which it is cast. Also has a cooldown timer 240 seconds (independent of resting). During the duration of Timestop, if a PC has greater than 50% of their maximum HP, they gain 100% immunity to physical damage. When cast by [[Spellsword|Spellswords]] (including when cast by a [[Spellsword|Spellswords]] from scrolls or items), the spell's effect is delayed by one round, and only creatures in a 20m radius around the original target location are affected.

name: True Seeing
description: The target creature can see through sanctuary and invisibility effects, and automatically spots hiding opponents. True Sight effect will only last 1 round. For Turns/level, the target receives See Invisibility and Ultravision. For rounds/level, the target receives +15 spot, not applicable toward piercing disguises. Each [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Divination|Spell Focus]] taken in Divination increases the duration of the True Sight effect by 1 (Normal), 1 (Greater) and 2 (Epic) for a total of 5 rounds. True sight still negates the +10 bonus to Bluff/Perform granted by Polymorphing. Sight-augmenting spells will default to less obtrusive eyeglow effects rather than the floating eyes. Purple eyeglow for the truesight duration, then white eyeglow.

name: Vampiric Touch
description: If the caster succeeds in striking a target with a melee touch attack, the target creature takes 1d6 points of negative energy damage for every 2 caster levels (maximum 10d6). This damage is then applied to the caster's hit points as a temporary bonus. You can't gain more temporary hit points than what is required to kill the target (target's current hit points +10).

name: Virtue
description: The target creature gains 1d3 temporary hit point per 3 caster levels above his maximum total.

name: Wail of the Banshee
description: All enemies within the area of effect must succeed at a fortitude save or die, to a maximum of 1 enemy per caster level. 10d6 sonic damage on a successful save.

name: Wall of Fire
description: This spell creates a curtain of fire that deals 2d6 + 1 per caster level points of fire damage to any creature that attempts to pass through it and double damage to undead. Does not damage corpses.

name: Web
description: Sticky strands cling to all creatures within the area of effect, entangling them. Creatures who make their save can move, but at a reduced rate depending on their strength.

name: Weird
description: A horrible phantasm rises to stand before enemy creatures in the area of effect, causing them to make a will save. If they fail, the phantasm touches them and they must now make a fortitude saving throw. If this saving throw fails, the creature dies. Those who succeed the fortitude save still take 3d6 points of psychic damage. Creatures with less than 4 hit dice automatically die, without any saving throws. Weird fears targets for 1 round / level on a failed will save. Targets that fail their fortitude saves still die.

name: Word of Faith
description: A wave of divine energy blasts all enemy creatures within the area of effect. Enemies level 4 or less: death, 5 to 7: stunned, confused, and blinded, 8 to 11: stunned and blinded, 12 or higher: blinded. Auto blind only lasts 9 seconds on successful fortitude save, normal duration on failed save. Targets blinded by by this spell are immune for 3 rounds before they can be blinded by it again. Any hostile summoned creatures are returned to their home planes.

name: Protection from Alignment
description: When this spell is cast, the caster chooses to be protected from either good, evil, law, or chaos. The spell target receives protection against creatures of the chosen alignment: +2 deflection bonus to armor class, +2 to all saving throws, and +4 will saves. Bonuses granted by multiple alignment spells are cumulative, but characters can only be warded against two alignments at a time. Bonus saves against neutral creatures are reduced by half and deflection AC only applies to chosen protections. The protections also reduce the [[Summoning_Changes#Alignment_divergence|alignment divergence]] probability that summons of the chosen alignments will turn hostile.

name: Magic Circle against Alignment
areaOfEffect: Medium (3.33 meters radius), around a single creature
description: When this spell is cast, the caster chooses to be protected from either good, evil, law, or chaos. The spell target and all party members within 3.3 meter radius receive protection against creatures of the chosen alignment: +2 deflection bonus to armor class, +2 to all saving throws, and +4 will saves. Bonuses granted by multiple alignment spells are cumulative, but characters can only be warded against two alignments at a time. Bonus saves against neutral creatures are reduced by half and deflection AC only applies to chosen protections. The protections also reduce the [[Summoning_Changes#Alignment_divergence|alignment divergence]] probability that summons of the chosen alignments will turn hostile.

name: Aura versus Alignment
description: When this spell is cast, the caster chooses to be protected from either good or evil. The caster and all nearby allies receives +6 will saves (+3 against neutrals) against creatures of the chosen alignment. The caster receives +4 Deflection AC, 5 + CL SR, and a damage shield of 6 + 1d8 damage against everyone. The holy aura damage shield deals divine damage, while the unholy aura damage shield deals negative energy damage. Damage shield spells (aka biteback) that cause damage to a melee attacker do not stack. The last spell cast overrides any other damage shield. All damage shield spells are moved to the top of the [[Breach List]]. One exception: these spells '''do''' stack with the damage shield of the [[Aura Versus Alignment]] spell. The protections also reduce the [[Summoning_Changes#Alignment_divergence|alignment divergence]] probability that summons of the chosen alignments will turn hostile.

name: Owls Wisdom
description: The target creature's wisdom is increased by 1d4 + 1. The bonus stacks across multiple castings to a maximum of +5 when cast without metamagic feats. The stacking bonus is the same between the single and mass-targeted versions, but both spells can stack towards the maximum.

name: Foxs Cunning
description: The target creature's intelligence is increased by 1d4 + 1. The bonus stacks across multiple castings to a maximum of +5 when cast without metamagic feats. The stacking bonus is the same between the single and mass-targeted versions, but both spells can stack towards the maximum.

name: Greater Bulls Strength
description: The target creature's strength is increased by 2d4 + 1.

name: Awaken
description: The target animal gains +1 bonus attack per round, +4 constitution, +1d10 wisdom, +4 strength, and +2 to attack rolls for as long as it remains at the caster's side, even between rests. Target animals are: any Animal, Beast, Magical Beast, and Vermin allies. Expected targets are [[Animal Companion|Animal Companions]], [[Skill changes|Animal Empathy]] Henchmen, and [[Summon Creature I|Summon Creature I]] through [[Summon Creature VI|VI]] summons. Player characters are excluded.

name: Creeping Doom
description: The caster summons a mass of biting and stinging insects which causes 1d6 points of piercing damage. For every subsequent round that a creature remains within the area of effect, the damage inflicted is increased by an increment of 1d6 (i.e. 1d6 for the first round, 2d6 for the second, 3d6 for the third, 4d6 for the fourth, and so on). The spell deals damage until its duration expires or it deals 1,000 points of damage. Also inflicts 1d20 piercing damage to a creature upon entering the insect swarm (which does not count against the damage limit) and applies a 50% movement speed decrease for as long as the creature remains in the area of effect.Persistent area spells do not stack with themselves. When the same spell is cast it will be replaced and refreshed. Different area spells may be stacked. Same spell by different caster stacks. The same spell may be cast away from 50% of the center of the Area of Effect (AoE) radius, allowing a section where they can overlap, and hit twice.

name: Ultravision
description: The target creature's ability to see in complete darkness is improved beyond that of darkvision. When this spell is applied even the effects of magical [[Darkness]] are pierced. Visual effect (and eyeglow) disabled.

name: Destruction
description: The target creature must make a fortitude save or die. A successful save still results in the target taking 10d6 points of entropy damage.

name: Ice Storm
description: All creatures in the area of effect take 3d6 points of bludgeoning damage and 2d6 points of cold damage. Ice storm will do an additional 1d6 cold damage per additional 3 caster levels.

name: Energy Buffer
description: The caster gains damage resistance 40/- against all elemental forms of damage. The spell ends after absorbing 100 points of damage from any single elemental type.

name: Negative Energy Burst
description: All creatures caught in the area of effect take 1d8 points of negative energy damage, +1 per caster level, to a maximum of +20. All creatures caught in the area also lose 1 point of strength per 4 caster levels. The strength malus lasts until it is removed by any restoration spell, or by resting. Negative energy spells have a reverse effect on undead, healing instead of harming them and giving a strength bonus.

name: Negative Energy Ray
description: A ray of negative energy slams into the target creature, doing 1d6 points of damage. After level 1, the spell does an additional 1d6 points of damage for every 2 caster levels, to a maximum of 5d6 at level 9. Negative energy spells have a reverse effect on undead, healing instead of harming them.

name: Aura of Vitality
description: All allies within the area of effect receive a +4 bonus to constitution, dexterity, and strength.

name: War Cry
description: The caster lets out a powerful shout that grants the caster a +2 bonus to attack and damage. All enemies within the area of effect are stricken with fear. Attack bonuses do not stack with [[Battletide]].

name: Regenerate
description: For the duration of the spell, the target creature gains the ability to regenerate and heals 4 + 1 / 6 levels each round. Does not stack with [[Monstrous Regeneration]] and/or itself.

name: Evards Black Tentacles
areaOfEffect: Large (5 meters radius), 1d4 tentacles + 1 / caster level (maximum 20)
description: A field of thick, 10 foot long rubbery tentacles rises from the ground. Each is capable of grappling a target doing 1d6+4 points bludgeoning damage. If successful, the target must then make a fortitude saving throw or become paralyzed by the grappling tentacle. The tentacles are randomly spread out over the area of effect allowing no more than half of the tentacles to reach a single target in any given round. Small creatures are not immune to the spell's effects.

name: Legend Lore
description: This spell grants the caster a +10 bonus to lore checks, +1 per 2 caster levels.

name: Find Traps
description: All traps within the area of effect are revealed, but are not disarmed.

name: Rogues Cunning
description: Provides a temporary +5 bonus to Open Locks and +10 bonus to Disable Trap, Hide, Move Silently, [[Search]], [[Sleight of Hand]] and [[Use Trap]].

name: Divine Favor
description: The caster gains a +1 bonus to attack and weapon damage rolls for every three caster levels (at least +1, to a maximum of +5). The color of the spell can be changed using the text command prior to casting: Green: -gre, White: -wht, Yellow: -yel, Orange: -ora, Red: -cri, Purple: -pur, Blue: -blu.

name: True Strike
description: Through magical intuition the caster gains a +20 bonus to attack rolls.

name: Flare
description: Inflicts 1d6 fire damage for every 3 caster levels to a single target creature.

name: Shield
description: The caster gains a +4 deflection bonus to AC. The caster gains Force damage reduction (DR). Notably, Bigby and Magic Missle lines of spells include Force type damage. [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Abjuration|Spell Focus: Abjuration]] increases the DR further: 1/- with no feats, 3/- with Spell Focus: Abjuration, 6/- with Greater Spell Focus: Abjuration, 12/- with Epic Spell Focus: Abjuration, and 16/- with Epic Spell Focus: Abjuration as Abjuration Specialist Wizard.

name: Entropic Shield
description: A magical field appears around the caster, causing any nearby enemies a 20% chance to miss on ranged attacks.

name: Continual Flame
description: This creates a magical flame that burns as bright as a torch until dispelled. It can be cast on any item that can be equipped to create a permanent source of light. The color of the spell can be changed using the text command prior to casting: Green: -gre, White: -wht, Yellow: -yel, Orange: -ora, Red: -cri, Purple: -pur, Blue: -blu.

name: One With The Land
description: The caster forges a strong link with nature, gaining a +4 competence bonus to animal empathy, hide, move silently, and set trap skills.

name: Camouflage
description: The caster's coloring changes to match the surroundings, gaining a +10 competence bonus to any hide checks. Does not stack with [[Mass Camouflage]].

name: Blood Frenzy
description: The caster enters a rage similar to that of a barbarian. Item/[[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Transmutation|Non-Transmutation Focus]] Blood Frenzy: +2 AB, +2 Dmg, +2 Will Save, -3 Ref Save, -2 AC, 1 round / level. From Spellbook: [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Transmutation|Spell Focus: Transmutation]] caster: +2 AB, +2 Dmg, +3 Will Save, -3 Ref Save, -2 AC, 2 round / level; [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Transmutation|Greater Spell Focus: Transmutation]] caster: +2 AB, +3 Dmg, +3 Will Save, -3 Ref Save, -2 AC, 3 round / level; [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Transmutation|Epic Spell Focus: Transmutation]] caster: +3 AB, +3 Dmg, +3 Will Save, -3 Ref Save, -2 AC, 4 round / level.

name: Bombardment
description: Rocks fall from the sky, causing 1d8 points of bludgeoning damage per caster level (to a maximum of 10d8) to all enemies in the area. Added reflex save against Daze (1 round). Party-friendly.

name: Acid Splash
description: Inflicts 1d6 acid damage for every 3 caster levels to a single target creature.

name: Earthquake
description: The caster causes a massive earthquake around himself, causing 1d6 points of damage per caster level (to a maximum of 30d6) to all creatures in the area of effect. The caster is not affected by the earthquake. Characters that fail the reflex save will be knocked down for 3 seconds.

name: Banishment
description: The caster targets a colossal area; summoned creatures of all types - familiars, animal companions, summons, undead, but NOT henchmen - caught in the area of effect must pass a DC or be banished. Creatures outside of their home plane are also susceptible to be banished are banished to the Hells, non-outsiders are banished back to the prime. A number of creatures equal to thrice the caster's level in HD can be banished. Blocks all summoning spells in the area where cast for 60 seconds; excluding animating undead creatures.

name: Inflict Minor Wounds
description: If the caster succeeds in striking an opponent with a touch attack, the target suffers 1d6 points of damage for every 3 caster levels. Inflict spells have a reverse effect when used on undead, causing the targeted undead to be healed by a lower 1d3 damage per 3 caster levels.

name: Inflict Light Wounds
description: If the caster succeeds in striking an opponent with a touch attack, the target suffers 2d8 points of damage, + 1 point per caster level. Inflict spells have a reverse effect when used on undead, causing the targeted undead to take an amount of healing equal to what the spell normally damages.

name: Inflict Moderate Wounds
description: If the caster succeeds in striking an opponent with a touch attack, the target suffers 4d8 points of damage + 1 / character level of the target; no maximum. Inflict spells have a reverse effect when used on undead, causing the targeted undead to take an amount of healing equal to what the spell normally damages.

name: Inflict Serious Wounds
description: If the caster succeeds in striking an opponent with a touch attack, the target suffers 6d8 points of damage + 1 / character level of the target; no maximum. Inflict spells have a reverse effect when used on undead, causing the targeted undead to take an amount of healing equal to what the spell normally damages.

name: Inflict Critical Wounds
description: If the caster succeeds in striking an opponent with a touch attack, the target suffers 8d8 points of damage + 1 / character level of the target; no maximum. Inflict spells have a reverse effect when used on undead, causing the targeted undead to take an amount of healing equal to what the spell normally damages.

name: Drown
description: The caster creates water in the lungs of a target creature. Any drowned creature takes 90% of its current hit points as bludgeoning damage (Fortitude save) and also takes 2d10+5 bludgeoning damage (no save). Golems and other nonliving creatures cannot be drowned.

name: Owls Insight
description: The target gains an enhancement bonus to wisdom equal to half the caster's level. Only affects characters with druid levels.

name: Electric Jolt
description: Inflicts 1d6 electrical damage for every 3 caster levels to a single target creature.

name: Firebrand
description: Masses of flame (one per caster level) appear and randomly target and hit any hostile creature in the area of effect. If there are more creatures than balls of flame, only the closest targets will be damaged. If there are more balls of flame than creatures, the excess balls of flame disappear. Each ball of flame explodes for 1d6 points of damage per caster level (max 15d6).

name: Wounding Whispers
description: The caster is surrounded with whispers that injure any creature that hits the caster for 1d6+1/level points of sonic damage. Damage shield spells (aka biteback) that cause damage to a melee attacker do not stack. The last spell cast overrides any other damage shield. All damage shield spells are moved to the top of the [[Breach List]]. One exception: these spells '''do''' stack with the damage shield of the [[Aura Versus Alignment]] spell.

name: Amplify
description: The caster or a target gains a +20 bonus to listen checks.

name: Greater Sanctuary
description: The caster becomes ethereal. No other creature can detect the caster. Attacking or performing a hostile action (including any summoning) will make the etherealness vanish. Has a cooldown timer of 240 seconds. Casting Greater Sanctuary will unsummon any Gate, Black Blade of Disaster, Epic Spell: Dragon Knight, Epic Spell: Mummy Dust, or Epic Spell: Planar Conduit spells currently cast.

name: Dirge
description: Surrounds the caster with an aura that applies incremental, stacking Damage Vulnerability to Sonic and Entropy damage per round to a maximum of 30% Sonic Vulnerability and 15% Entropy Vulnerability.<br><br>Sonic Vulnerability will accumulate at a rate of 5%/10%/15%/20%/25%/30%. Entropy Vulnerability will accumulate at a rate of 2%/5%/7%/10%/12%/15%.<br><br>The duration of the debuff will last 1 round per 3 caster levels.

name: Inferno
description: The caster causes a target to ignite into flame. Each round the target will suffer 2d6 points of fire damage. Damage increases to 3d6 with [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Transmutation|Greater Spell Focus: Transmutation]] and 4d6 with [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Transmutation|Epic Spell Focus: Transmutation]].

name: Isaacs Lesser Missile Storm
description: A number of energy missiles (one per caster level but to a maximum of 10) appear and randomly target and hit any hostile creature in the area of effect. If there are more creatures than missiles, only the closest targets will be damaged. If there are more missiles than creatures, one of the creatures will be hit with multiple missiles. Each missile does 1d6 points of force damage.

name: Isaacs Greater Missile Storm
description: A number of energy missiles (one per caster level but to a maximum of 20) appear and randomly target and hit any hostile creature in the area of effect. If there are more creatures than missiles, only the closest targets will be damaged. If there are more missiles than creatures, one of the creatures will be hit with multiple missiles. Each missile does 2d6 points of force damage. Cannot strike one target with more than ten missiles. This limits it to only producing ten missiles if only one viable target is present upon casting.

name: Bane
description: Bane fills the caster's enemies with fear and doubt. They suffer a -1 penalty on their attack rolls and a -1 penalty on saving throws against fear.

name: Shield of Faith
description: The target gains a +2 deflection bonus to their armor class, with an additional +1 bonus for every six levels of the caster (maximum of +5).

name: Planar Ally
description: An outsider is summoned to assist the caster. The type of outsider is dependent upon the specific summon [[Summoning_Changes#Summoning_Streams|stream]]. Conjuring a summon that is different from the caster's alignment is subject to [[Summoning_Changes#Alignment_divergence|alignment divergence]] and losing control of the summon. One can see the chance of hostility using the [[Console_command#-stream|-stream]] command, use [[Console_command#-stream|-stream ?]] for more details.

name: Magic Fang
description: This spell strengthens the caster's animal companion, giving it +1 to hit and +1 to damage. It also grants the creature the ability to strike as if it were a +1 weapon (so it can bypass other creatures' x/+1 damage reduction).

name: Greater Magic Fang
description: This spell strengthens the caster's animal companion, providing a +1 bonus to attack bonus and damage, with an additional +1 for every seven levels of the caster: +1 at level 1, +2 at level 7, +3 at level 14, +4 at level 21, and +5 at level 28. This spell also gives an enhancement bonus equal to the attack bonus granted for the purposes of damage reduction penetration. Additionally, the animal companion is given bonus AC equal to twice the total attack bonus granted: +2 AC at level 1, +4 AC at level 7, +6 AC at level 14, +8 AC at level 21, and +10 AC at level 28. The spell grants Damage Reduction (Bonus)*2/+(Bonus) as well, with values of 2/+1 at level 1, 4/+2 at level 7, 6/+3 at level 14, 8/+4 at level 21, and 10/+5 at level 28.

name: Spike Growth
description: Covers the terrain with small spikes. Any creature will suffer 1d4 per 3 caster level points of damage each round that they remain within the afflicted area. These spikes can damage the victim's legs, so that even once they are free of the spike growth, their movement rate is slowed for 1 round per caster level.

name: Mass Camouflage
description: All allies in the area of effect gain a +10 bonus to their hide skill. Does not stack with [[Camouflage]].

name: Expeditious Retreat
description: The caster becomes 150% faster than their normal movement rate, allowing them to flee from dangerous encounters. This spell has no effect if the caster is already hasted.

name: Tashas Hideous Laughter
description: If the target fails their saving throw they will begin laughing hysterically. They will be unable to defend themselves until the spell wears off. A creature whose racial type is different from the caster's gains a +4 bonus on its saving throw because humor doesn't 'translate' well.

name: Displacement
description: The target gains 50% concealment, displacing the caster's image several feet to the side, similar to the abilities of a displacer beast. Removes the [[Faerie Fire]] effect on the target it is cast upon.

name: Bigbys Interposing Hand
description: A giant hand appears over the target, making it difficult for him to attack. He receives a -10 penalty to all attack rolls for the duration of the spell.

name: Bigbys Forceful Hand
description: A target that fails its save is knocked down and is dazed for the duration of the spell.

name: Bigbys Grasping Hand
description: A giant hand appears and attacks the target. If the target fails its save, it will be held for the duration of the spell.

name: Bigbys Clenched Fist
description: A giant hand appears and attacks the target, once each round for the duration of the spell. Each hit causes 1d8+11 points of force damage to the target and if they fail their saving throw they are stunned for that round as well.

name: Bigbys Crushing Hand
description: A giant hand appears and attacks the target. If the target fails its save, the target is held fast for the duration of the spell and suffers 2d6+12 points of force damage each round.

name: Cats Grace
description: The target creature's dexterity is increased by 1d4 + 1. The bonus stacks across multiple castings to a maximum of +5 when cast without metamagic feats. The stacking bonus is the same between the single and mass-targeted versions, but both spells can stack towards the maximum.

name: Flesh to stone
description: The subject and all possessions it carries turns into a mindless, inert statue. Only a [[Stone to Flesh]] spell can restore the subject to normal.

name: Stone to flesh
description: This spell restores a petrified creature to its normal state, restoring life and goods.

name: Crumble
description: This spell inflicts 1d6 points of entropy damage per caster level to a selected construct (to a maximum of 20d6). This spell does not affect living creatures, but does work against petrified creatures.

name: Infestation of Maggots
description: With but a touch, you infect a target with maggot-like creatures. They deal 1d4 points of temporary constitution damage each round. Each round the subject makes a new fortitude save. The spell ends if the target succeeds at its saving throw.

name: Healing Sting
description: You inflict 1d6 + 1 damage per 2 caster levels to a cap of 10d6 + 10, to living creatures touched and gain an equal amount of hit points. If the target dies, the caster receives the excess of healing as temporary HP over the maximum by hour per 2 caster level.

name: Great Thunderclap
description: You create a loud noise equivalent to a peal of thunder and its accompanying shock wave. The spell has three effects. First, all creatures in the area must make will saves to avoid being stunned for 1 round. Second, the creatures must make fortitude saves or be deafened for 1 minute. Third, they must make reflex saves or fall prone.

name: Ball Lightning
description: The caster creates up to 15 balls, 1 ball per target, that each strike different targets. Each ball doing 1d6/CL lightning damage, max 15d6 damage per ball.

name: Battletide
description: You create an aura that steals energy from your enemies. Your enemies suffer a -2 circumstance penalty on saving throws, attack rolls, and damage rolls, once entering the aura. On casting, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your saves, attack rolls, and damage rolls. Attack bonuses do not stack with [[War Cry]].

name: Combust
description: This spell makes a creature burst into flame. The initial eruption of flame causes 2d6 fire damage +1 point per caster level (maximum +10) with no saving throw. Further, the creature must make a reflex save or catch fire taking a further 1d6 points of damage. This will continue until the reflex save is made.

name: Death Armor
description: A magical aura surrounds the caster — injuring creatures that touch it. Any creature striking the caster takes 1d4 points of magical damage +1 point per 2 caster levels (maximum +5). Damage shield spells (aka biteback) that cause damage to a melee attacker do not stack. The last spell cast overrides any other damage shield. All damage shield spells are moved to the top of the [[Breach List]]. One exception: these spells '''do''' stack with the damage shield of the [[Aura Versus Alignment]] spell.

name: Gedlees Electric Loop
description: You create a small stroke of lightning that cycles through all creatures in the area of effect. The spell deals 1d8 points of damage per 2 caster levels (maximum 10d8). Those who fail their reflex saves must succeed at a will save or be stunned for 1 round.<br><br>'''Note''': With GSF Evocation the spell does not target friendly units. Elementalist (Air) - The area of effect increased from Small to Medium.

name: Horizikauls Boom
description: You blast the target with loud and high-pitched sounds. The target takes 1d4 points of sonic damage per two caster levels (maximum 15d4) and must make a will save or be deafened for 1d4 rounds

name: Ironguts
description: When touched, the target creature gains a +4 circumstance bonus on fortitude saves against all poisons. Halves Sobriety gain from [[Heal Potion|Heal Potions]]. Can be removed/countered by Poison or Disease. Has been moved to the top of the [[Breach List]].

name: Mestils Acid Breath
description: You breathe forth a cone of acidic droplets. The cone inflicts 1d6 points of acid damage per caster level (maximum 15d6) to all hostiles and fixtures within its area of effect.

name: Mestils Acid Sheath
description: This spell creates an acid shield around your person. Any creature striking you with its body does normal damage, but at the same time the attacker takes 1d6 points +2 points per caster level of acid damage. Damage shield spells (aka biteback) that cause damage to a melee attacker do not stack. The last spell cast overrides any other damage shield. All damage shield spells are moved to the top of the [[Breach List]]. One exception: these spells '''do''' stack with the damage shield of the [[Aura Versus Alignment]] spell.

name: Monstrous Regeneration
description: For the duration of the spell, the target creature gains the ability to regenerate 3 hit points every round. Does not stack with [[Regenerate (spell)|Regenerate]] and/or itself.

name: Scintillating Sphere
description: The caster unleashes a crackling electric projectile that explodes upon all within the area of effect for 1d6 points of electrical damage per caster level, to a maximum of 15d6.

name: Stone Bones
description: You cause the affected undead in an area to gain a natural armor class bonus, due to the thickening of its bones. AC based on the caster's level: 1-6 +3, 7-12 +4, 13+ 5.

name: Undeath to Death
description: This spell slays 1d4 HD worth of undead creatures per caster level to a maximum 20d4. Necromancy specialist Wizards and casters with Epic Spell Focus: Necromancy will not be subject to the 20CL maximum. Creatures with the fewest HD are affected first; among creatures with equal HD, those closest to the point of origin of the burst are affected first. Does not kill or impact the caster's own undead summons.

name: Vine Mine
description: When casting vine mine, the caster must select one of the following effects that will be created in the targeted area: entangle (as the spell), hamper movement (movement speed is halved), camouflage (add +4 competence bonus on hide checks).

name: Shelgarns Persistent Blade
description: The caster summons a dagger that acts as a faithful and loyal servant.

name: Blade Thirst
description: You grant a slashing weapon an enhancement bonus: 2 + 1 / 5 levels beyond the 11th (i.e. +2 at level 11, +3 at level 16, +4 at level 21, +5 at level 26). Additionally, when the enchanted weapon is wielded by a character with [[Ranger]] levels, it grants an equivalent amount of self heal upon every hit. [[Blade Thirst]] may be cast on any kind of melee weapon. If targeted on a creature, the spell will enchant the weapon in the primary hand of the target. Non-restricted weapon enchantment.

name: Deafening Clang

classes.domain: Air Domain, Destruction Domain, Forge Domain, War Domain

description: You empower a weapon with sonic damage scaling with Caster Level: 1-13 +1d4 sonic damage, 14-20 +1d6 sonic damage, 21-27 +1d8 sonic damage, 28+ +1d10 sonic damage. This spell occupies the Temporary Essence slot on a weapon. Non-restricted weapon enchantment.

name: Keen Edge
description: Adds the keen property to the targeted edged melee weapon. Based on the hit dice of the creature holding the weapon and caster level for duration: 1-6 +1 AB Keen 1d4 massive criticals, 7-11 +2 AB Keen 1d8 massive criticals, 12-17 +3 AB Keen 2d6 massive criticals, 18+ +4 AB Keen 2d8 massive criticals. Restricted weapon enchantment.

name: Blackstaff
description: Enchants a weapon so that on hit, the target must make a will save. Failing the save inflicts a cumulative 5% vulnerability to magic damage and 10% vulnerability to elemental damage. This malus can be stacked up to 10 times, capping at 50%/100%. The malus duration is 6 rounds, but it is refreshed with every new application. This spell also has a target selection (it is not a personal spell only). Damage vulnerabilities can only increase once per round. Damage vulnerabilities applied by Blackstaff are affected by restoration spells and abilities. Also applies vulnerability against negative energy. Non-restricted weapon enchantment.

name: Elemental Weapon
description: Sets a melee weapon aflame for AB and damage, based on the hit dice of the creature holding the weapon: 1-6 +1 AB 2 damage, 7-11 +2 AB 4 damage, 12-17 +2 AB 6 damage, 18+ +3 AB 8 damage. Fire damage by default, but can be changed with [[Console_command#-stream|-stream]] selections. Restricted weapon enchantment.

name: Ice Dagger
description: You create a piece of ice that flies toward the target and deals 1d4 points of cold damage per level (maximum of 20d4).

name: Stonehold
description: Creates a cloud that paralyzes any creatures inside of it, encasing them in stone for 1d6 rounds. Persistent area spells do not stack with themselves. When the same spell is cast it will be replaced and refreshed. Different area spells may be stacked. Same spell by different caster stacks. The same spell may be cast away from 50% of the center of the Area of Effect (AoE) radius, allowing a section where they can overlap, and hit twice.

name: Darkfire
description: Enchant a weapon for AB and damage, based on the hit dice of the creature holding the weapon: 1-6 +1 AB 2 damage, 7-11 +2 AB 4 damage, 12-17 +2 AB 6 damage, 18+ +3 AB 8 damage. The damage type is fire. Restricted weapon enchantment.

name: Glyph of Warding
description: The caster creates a small, magical zone that can detect the passage of enemy creatures. When the field is activated, it explodes, doing 1d6 points of sonic damage per two caster levels to all creatures within the area of effect (to a maximum of 10d6). After being triggered, the glyph dissipates.

name: Evil Blight
description: All enemies within the area are subjected to one of the curses:<br>Curse of Fatigue: -4 physical ability drain (-6 on ESF Necromancy)[Fort Save][Permanent]<br>Curse of Slumber: Sleep (NPC 3 hours; PC 3 turns) [Will Save].<br>Curse of Doubt: -2 AB, AC, Prevents Good Hope Spell bonus [Fort Save][Permanent].

name: Cloud of Bewilderment
description: The caster blows forth a cloud of noxious air. Enemies in the area of effect are stunned and blinded for 1d6 rounds. Persistent area spells do not stack with themselves. When the same spell is cast it will be replaced and refreshed. Different area spells may be stacked. Same spell by different caster stacks. The same spell may be cast away from 50% of the center of the Area of Effect (AoE) radius, allowing a section where they can overlap, and hit twice.

name: Hell Inferno
description: The caster causes a target to ignite into flame, those who fail a reflex save vs. Fire suffer a -4 penalty to attack and damage rolls. Twice each round the target will suffer 2d6 points of <b>variable</b> (see Notes: default Fire) damage and 2d6 points of Magic damage. Cannot be extended.

name: Chaos Shield
description: Chaos Shield increases a Wild Mage's chance to gain a favorable result when a wild surge occurs. Every time a roll is made on the Wild Surge chart, your roll starts at 15 changing the roll to 15 + d85 on the chart. The roll is increased by +1 for each Caster Level, capping at 45 at Level 30. This effect is permanent until it expires after 1 + 1 wild surge per five Caster Levels (Maximum of 7 at Level 30) are triggered or when the caster rests. '''NOTE: This spell can only be used by Wild Mages.'''

name: Improved Chaos Shield
description: Casts a protective aura of wild magic around the caster. Enemies entering and lingering inside the aura has a chance to trigger a random Chaos Shield effect. The chance starts at 20% and will increase for each round there are hostiles inside the Aura but will reset back to 20% as soon as the Chaos Shield triggers and start to work its way back up again. Chaos Shield effects: Stun, Fire Damage, Electrical Damage, Blindness, Slow, Knockdown, Miss & Immobilize, Sleep, Attack Bonus Penalty, Cold Damage and Frozen. '''NOTE: This spell can only be used by Wild Mages.'''

name: Disintegrate
description: A thin, green ray springs from your pointing finger. You must make a successful ranged touch attack to hit. Any creature struck by the ray takes 2d3 points of entropy damage per caster level (to a maximum of 40d3). Any creature reduced to 0 or fewer hit points by this spell is entirely disintegrated, leaving behind only a trace of fine dust. A disintegrated creature’s equipment is unaffected. A creature or object that makes a successful Fortitude save takes half damage. If this damage reduces the creature or object to 0 or fewer hit points, it is entirely disintegrated.

name: Halt Undead
description: This spell renders as many as three undead creatures immobile. A nonintelligent undead creature gets no saving throw; an intelligent undead creature does. If the spell is successful, it renders the undead creature immobile for the duration of the spell. This spell has no impact your own undead summons.

name: Blasphemy
description: Any creature within the area of a blasphemy spell suffers the following ill effects based on the difference between caster's Caster Level and target's hit die: Up to caster level -1: Dazed; -5: Dazed, Weakened (d4 Rounds); -10: Dazed, Weakened, Paralyzed (d3 Rounds); -10: Dazed, Weakened, Paralyzed, Killed (If not Immune). The effects are cumulative and concurrent. No saving throw is allowed against these effects.

name: Crushing Despair
description: An invisible cone of despair causes great sadness in the subjects. Each affected creature takes a -2 penalty on attack rolls, saving throws, skill checks, and weapon damage rolls. If they are under the effect of [[Good Hope]], it will be removed before applying the malus.

name: Good Hope
description: This spell instills powerful hope in the subjects. Each affected creature gains a +2 morale bonus on saving throws and skill checks.

name: Faerie Fire
description: A pale glow surrounds and outlines the target and will remove concealment benefits from blur, displacement, invisibility, or similar magical effects.

name: Maze
description: You banish a creature into a labyrinthine demiplane. The target remains there for the duration of the spell. Freedom of Movement (and -respite) protects against Maze. Targets returning from Maze will give off a burst of wind, removing all AoE effects within a radius of the return location. Higher CR mobs (end-tier bosses) cannot be affected by Maze.

name: Wall of Ice
description: This spell creates a curtain of ice that deals 2d6 + 1 per Caster Level points of cold damage to any creature that attempts to pass through it.

name: Scorching Ray
description: You blast your enemies with fiery rays. You may fire one ray, plus one additional ray for every four levels beyond 3rd (to a maximum of five rays at 19th level). Each ray requires a ranged touch attack to hit and deals 3d6 points of fire damage.<br><br>'''Note''': Elementalist (Fire) - Can fire an additional ray at caster level 23 and another one at 27.

name: Chromatic Orb
description: This spell causes a sphere to move against the target. The caster must make a successful ranged touch attack to hit the target. Once struck the target takes 1d8 points of damage of different element per two caster levels (to a maximum of 5d8 at Level 9).

name: Avascular Mass
description: You shoot a black ray of necromantic energy from your outstretched hand, causing your foe to violently purge blood vessels through its skin. The purged blood vessels spread outward, creating a many-layered mass of bloody, adhesive tissue that traps nearby creatures in a gory horror. You must succeed on a ranged touch attack with the ray to strike a target. If the attack is successful, the subject loses half its hit points (capped at 10 HP per Caster Level) and is stunned for 1 round. On a successful Fortitude saving throw, the damage is halved and the subject is not stunned. Nearby enemies around the target must also roll a Fortitude saving throw or be stunned for 1 Round as well. Any sort of mind immunity will automatically be partial for the target. Damage type is Negative.

name: Scintillating Pattern
description: A twisting pattern of discordant, coruscating colors weaves through the air, affecting creatures within it. The spell affects a total number of Hit Dice of creatures equal to your caster level (maximum 20). Hit Dice remaining that are not sufficient to affect a creature are wasted and the spell is spent. The spell affects each subject according to its Hit Dice: 6 or less Unconscious for 1d4 rounds, stunned for 1d4 rounds, confused for 1d4 rounds. 7 to 12 Stunned for 1d4 rounds, confused for 1d4 rounds. 13 to 20 Confused for 1d4 rounds. Greater than 20 includes a will save Confused for 1d4 rounds. Blind creatures are not affected by scintillating pattern.

name: Nightmare
description: You send a hideous and unsettling phantasmal vision to the creature you target. The nightmare prevents restful sleep and causes fatigue and 1d10 points of psychic damage per two caster levels (max 15d10) on already sleeping targets (sleeping targets will wake up from this). The nightmare is a Nightmare Curse and is permanent. Creatures who don't sleep (such as elves) are immune to this spell. Added Maximize Spell and Empower Spell metamagic feat.

name: Bigbys Disrupting Hand
description: A small, spectral hand springs into existence before your target. It hovers in the air, ready to deliver a backhanded blow when the subject attempts to cast a spell. This attack causes no damage, but it forces the subject to make a Concentration check with a DC equal to this spell's save DC. If the subject fails the check, the hand's blow ruins the casting attempt.

name: Sound Lance
description: This spell causes a targeted area effect of intense sonic energy dealing 1d8 points of sonic damage per caster level (maximum 10d8). If the target(s) fail the Fortitude save they are deafened. The sound lance cannot penetrate the area of a silence spell.

name: Finger of Agony
description: As you crook your finger, your enemy feels their vitals rupture within them. You magically disrupt the subject's internal organs, causing it great pain. The target becomes Sickened for 3 rounds. The first round the target takes 3d6 and each subsequent round the damage increases by 1d6 ending at 5d6 on round 3. A successful Fortitude save halves the damage and avoids Sickened for that round.

name: Freeze
description: A violent blue ray swirled with white streaks emerges from your outstretched hand striking your target. You must make a successful ranged touch attack to hit. A target struck takes 10d6 points of cold damage, fortitude save for half, and must succeed on a Reflex save or be Frozen for 1 round per caster level.

name: Iceberg
saves: Reflex 1/2 damage and ignore the immobilization effect
description: Iceberg is a brutal and direct spell dealing 1d6 blunt and cold damage per two caster levels to targets closest to the center. Affected targets will be encased in ice if they fail a saving throw, effectively immobilizing them for 1d3 rounds. Creatures larger than Medium are unaffected by the immobilizing effect. Targets inside the center of the spell (within 5m) have an increased save DC +3 for damage and immobilizing effects

name: Detect Poison
description: You determine whether a creature or an object has been poisoned or is poisonous. With Greater Spell Focus in [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Divination|Divination]] you can determine the exact type of poison and the severity. Epic Spell Focus in [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Divination|Divination]] reveals the gender and race of the poisoner.

name: Daltims fiery Tentacles
areaOfEffect: Large (5 meter radius), 1d4 tentacles + 1 / caster level (maximum 20)
description: A field of thick, 10 foot long fiery tentacles erupt from the ground. Each is capable of grappling a target doing 1 point of fire damage per caster level(maximum 15). If grappled, the target must then make a fortitude saving throw or become paralyzed by the grappling tentacles. The tentacles are randomly spread out over the area of effect allowing no more than half of the tentacles to reach a single target in any given round. Small creatures are not immune to the spell's effects.

name: Kyristans malevolent Tentacles
areaOfEffect: Large (5 meter radius), 1d4 tentacles + 1 / caster level (maximum 20)
description: A field of thick, 10 foot life draining tentacles erupt from the ground. Each is capable of grappling a target. If grappled, the target takes 1d4+1 negative damage per tentacle (or with ESF Necromancy: Entropy Damage) and must then make fortitude saving throws against level drain(1d3) and paralysis. The tentacles are randomly spread out over the area of effect allowing no more than half of the tentacles to reach a single target in any given round. Small creatures are not immune to the spell's effects.

name: Darkbolt
description: You unleash beams of darkness from your open palm. You must succeed on a ranged touch attack to strike your target(s). You can hurl one bolt for every two caster levels you have (maximum seven bolts). A darkbolt deals 2d6 points of magic damage to a living creature, and the creature is dazed for 1 round unless it makes a Will save. A creature struck by multiple bolts during the same round can only be dazed for 1 round. An undead creature takes no damage but is slowed for 1 round if it fails it's save.

name: Mass Hold Monster
description: This spell functions like Hold Person, except that it affects multiple creatures and holds (paralyzes) any living creature that fails its Will save.

name: Shadow Plague
description: Conjure a cloud of shadow energy from the plane of shadow that deals 4d6 cold damage + 1d6 per 2 levels per round and blinds enemies as if the darkness spell. Lesser light spells are not able to disperse the darkness, unless a Sunburst or greater.

name: Lightning Shield
description: This spell creates a lightning shield around your person. Any creature striking you with its body does normal damage, but at the same time the attacker takes 1d6 points +3 points per 2 caster levels of electrical damage. The caster also gains 25% immunity to electrical damage. Damage shield spells (aka biteback) that cause damage to a melee attacker do not stack. The last spell cast overrides any other damage shield. All damage shield spells are moved to the top of the [[Breach List]]. One exception: these spells '''do''' stack with the damage shield of the [[Aura Versus Alignment]] spell.

name: Frost Shield
description: The caster is surrounded by a ring of frost that damages all opponents who make a successful melee attack on the caster. The damage inflicted is 1d6 cold, +1 point per caster level. The caster also gains 50% immunity to cold and fire. Damage shield spells (aka biteback) that cause damage to a melee attacker do not stack. The last spell cast overrides any other damage shield. All damage shield spells are moved to the top of the [[Breach List]]. One exception: these spells '''do''' stack with the damage shield of the [[Aura Versus Alignment]] spell.

name: Water Breathing
description: This spell grants creatures in the area of effect the ability to breath underwater until the spell ends.  Affected creatures also retain their normal mode of respiration.

name: Dark Undertow
description: Limbs of a thalassic horror break through a gash in reality, reaching for the target. If the caster succeeds at a ranged touch attack, the target gets pulled to a nearby location soon after.

name: Sacred Flame
description: Inflicts between 1d3 and 1d6 damage for every 3 caster levels to a single target creature, depending on the distance between caster and target. Damage type is dependent on caster alignment or the current stream. Good/Neutral casters default to Positive damage, Evil casters default to Negative damage. Damage type can be changed via planar streams (see [[Console_command#-stream|-stream]]), the celestial stream deals Positive damage. The demon, devil, and yugoloth streams deal Negative damage.

name: Frostbite
description: This spell makes a creature experience extreme cold. The initial touch of cold causes 2d4 cold damage +1 point per caster level (maximum +8) with no saving throw. Further, in each round the creature must make a fortitude save or freeze taking a further 1d4 points of damage and slowed for 10% less movement speed. This will continue until the fortitude save is made.

name: Frost Nova
description: You invoke the arctic cold to freeze your foes. All creatures other than yourself within 20 feet of you must succeed on a reflex saving throw or take 1d4 cold damage per caster level (up to a maximum of 15d4), rooted for 1 round, and suffer -3 reflex saving throws for 1 turn. On a successful save, a target takes half damage and does not become rooted or suffer a disadvantage on reflex saves.

name: Sustenance
description: Restores 50% of food and water rating; rest by 10%; and increases sobriety by 10%.

name: Vitriolic Sphere
description: The caster throws a massive glob of acidic goo that splashes upon all within the area of effect for 1d6 points of acid damage per caster level, to a maximum of 20d6.

name: Sunfire
description: The spell causes everything within the area of effect to be bathed in harsh sunlight. All those caught in the destruction take 1d8 points of fire damage per 2 caster levels up to a maximum of 10d8 damage. Undead creatures take an extra 1d8 divine damage per 2 caster levels up to a maximum of 10d8 damage. Light-sensitive races may have their sensitivity triggered on a failed save.

name: Moonbeam
description: The cast sends a shimmering beam of silvery-white moonlight at a target. The damage and effects are based on the target's racial type. Other: 1d6 magic and 1d6 divine to the main target for every 2 caster levels, to a maximum of 6d6 each. (12d6 total) Deals half the amount on the secondary, area of effect targets (within 1m (3.33ft) of the main target) Undead: Takes +50% more Divine damage Shapechanger: Takes +50% more Magic damage. The main target must make a will save or be stunned for one round. Secondary targets are not subject to the stun.

name: ELEMENTAL HAMMER
description: You invoke an elemental explosion to daze your foes. All creatures within the selected area will take damage (will reduces the damage to d4s) and are potentially dazed for 1 round (Will negates). The impact has a chance to lower the reflex save of the targets for 1 round (-2). Damage type depends on [[Elementalist|Elementalist's]] chosen element; damage is d6 per caster level (max 20d6).<br>Applies Empower Metamagic if the focus is above 50%.<br><br>'''Damage Special:''' Targets with Evasion; or under the effect of the [[Minor_Globe_of_Invulnerability|minor globe of invulnerability]] receive 25% less damage, and those with Improved Evasion; or under the effect of the [[Globe_of_Invulnerability|globe of invulnerability]] receive 50 less damage. The calculation is applied before the main saving throw which can further halve the outcome. <br><br>'''Daze Special:''' Targets with Improved Evasion, under the effect of globe of invulnerability, or minor globe of invulnerability won't be dazed.

name: ELEMENTAL ANNIHILATION
description: You invoke a potent explosion to crush your foes. All creatures within the selected area will take d6+1 per caster level (max 30d6+30) damage (Will halves) and are potentially dazed for d3 rounds (Will negates). Damage type depends on Elementalist's chosen element. Daze will apply when Focus > 50. <br><br>Enemies struck by Elemental Annihilation are immune to the spell for 1 round.<br><br>'''Damage Special:''' Targets with Evasion; or under the effect of the [[Minor_Globe_of_Invulnerability|minor globe of invulnerability]] receive 25% less damage, and those with Improved Evasion; or under the effect of the [[Globe_of_Invulnerability|globe of invulnerability]] receive 50 less damage. The calculation is applied before the main saving throw which can further halve the outcome.<br><br>'''Daze Special:''' Targets with Improved Evasion or under the effect of globe of invulnerability won't be dazed.

name: BLUR
description: The target's body takes on a magical blur that hinders attacks. They gain 30% concealment for the duration.

name: Spider Skin
description: The caster transforms an intended target's skin to be more like that of a spider, sprouting tiny hooks on their palms and feet that allow them to scale vertical surfaces more easily and granting them enhanced maneuverability. They gain +3 Natural AC and a +4 bonus to Climb and Move Silently for the duration.

name: FALSE LIFE
description: The caster uses necromantic energy to avoid death. They gain temporary hit points equally to 1d10 + 1 per caster level, to a maximum of hit points equal to their caster level. Cannot be placed on wands or potions. Does not stack with other sources of temporary hitpoints.

name: BLADES OF FIRE
description: The caster ignites the subject's melee weapons, allowing each to deal an additional 2d4 worth of fire damage for the duration. The damage increases to 2d6 at level 9, 2d8 at level 18, and 2d10 at level 27. This spell does not stack with Darkfire or Elemental Weapon. Non-restricted weapon enchantment.

name: LIFE TRANSFERENCE
description: The caster sacrifices some of their health to mend another friendly creature's (that is sustained by life force) injuries. The caster take 8d4 Magical damage, which can't be reduced in any way, and the target creature regains a number of hit points equal to three times the damage you take. This spell will never drop the caster below 1 hit point, but if no damage is dealt to them, no healing will be done either.

name: FRIGID DARKNESS
description: A sphere of darkness shoots out towards the target. The caster makes a ranged touch attack. On a hit, the subject takes 2d10 + 2 damage per 2 caster levels, half of which is Cold and half of which is Entropic, has its movement speed reduced by 10% for 1d2 rounds, and on a failed fortitude save is Blinded for 3 rounds.

name: Serene Visage
description: The caster enhances their appearance to appear more persuasive or interesting. They gain a bonus of +4 to all disguise checks but it is not a straight Bluff or Persuade bonus; has its own icon to tell you whether it's active or not, and applies the +4 bonus to disguise checks silently.

name: Withering Ray
description: The caster creates 1 beam per 3 Caster Level, to a maximum of 5 beams of necromantic energy and hurls them at targets within range and within the radius of the area of effect. They make a ranged touch attack for each ray and only one ray can strike a target at a time. On a hit, the target takes 10 + 1d4 Entropic damage per caster levels up to a maximum of 20d4. Targets struck by the rays are allowed a fortitude save to only take half damage. If this damage reduces a living target to 0 hit points, it dies instantly and withers into a husk. Inorganic targets such as constructs do not wither but are not immune to this spell's damage.

name: Strangulate
description: An invisible hand reaches out from the caster, grabbing the subject's throat and strangling them. The target makes a Reflex save. If they fail, the target is restrained and can't speak or cast spells with verbal components. If the caster attempts to do anything else while the spell is active, their concentration may break and the spell may end. The spell takes no effect against creatures that do not need to breathe, like oozes, elementals, undead, constructs, air genasi. The target receives feedback about the effect.

name: Spinal Tap
description: The caster uses necromancy to reach into a subject's flesh and cause harm to their spine. The target rolls a Will save. If they fail, they are paralyzed for the duration and receive 1d8 Negative damage for every 3 caster levels. If they succeed, they still receive 1d4 Negative damage for every 3 caster levels. If the caster has Greater Spell Focus in Necromancy, the Negative damage instead becomes Entropic.

name: Power Word Bleed
description: The caster speaks a word of power upon a single target. If the target has 120 hit points or fewer, it is subject to massive bleeding, taking half of its current hit points in damage up to a maximum of 60. In addition to the damage, they must roll a fortitude save based on their remaining hit points (+1 to the DC at 120, +2 at 80, +3 at 60 or lower) or begin to bleed for 3d8 damage each round for 5 rounds. This spell has no effect on undead nor constructs.

name: CHILL TOUCH
description: The caster creates a ghostly, skeletal hand in the space of a creature within range. They must make a ranged touch attack against the ceature to assail it with the chill of the grave. On a hit, the target takes 1d2 Entropic and 1d2 Cold damage per 3 caster levels and is sent into a shivering frenzy, receiving a -2 penalty to their Heal and Concentration skills for every 9 caster levels for 1d3 rounds. If the target is undead, it must succeed a Will save or receives a -1 penalty to its Attack bonus per 9 caster levels for 1d3 rounds. The debuff is not applied if caster level is lower than the HD of the target.

name: Vengeful Mount
description: The caster tests the emotional bond between rider and mount. Targeting a mounted creature, they attempt to disrupt their mount's focus. The rider must roll a Ride + d20 check versus the caster's Animal Empathy, 1/2 Spellcraft, or 1/2 Intimidate (whichever comes out highest) + d20 or be thrown from their horse.

name: GREATER MAGE ARMOR
description: The target receives +8 to their Armor Class bonus (+2 Deflection, +2 Armor, +2 Natural, +2 Dodge). Does not stack with other sources of Mage Armor. This spell confers no effect when cast from a scroll, but it may be scribed for the purpose of learning.

name: NEGATIVE ENERGY FLOOD
description: The caster sends ribbons of Negative energy at a single target, striking them with 1d6 damage per caster level up to 20d6, fortitude save for half and an additional effect. If the target fails the fortitude save, they also lose 1 point of Strength per 4 Caster Levels. Strength bonuses from spells of similar types (such as Negative Energy Burst) will not stack when granted to an undead creature. If a target is killed by this spell, it rises as an uncontrolled zombie. This spell has a reverse effect on undead, healing them instead of harming them.

name: Wraith Stride
description: The caster suffuses themselves with necromantic power, briefly gaining the traits of an incorporeal undead. They are rendered invisible, granted a 30% Movement Speed increase, [[Freedom of Movement]], and are able to move freely through other creatures. Making a combat action while within the Wraith Stride will break the effect. This spell can be breached.

name: PHANTOM WOUND
description: The target creature must succeed a Will save or suffer a Phantom Wound: a grievious wound that only they can see. Subjects affected by waves of pain caused by imaginary wound and will receive 1d6 per caster level (Max 15d6) points of psychic damage (will negates). Upon successful initial saving throw, on the following round the pain grows as the wound deepens forcing repetition of the saving throw, upon failure the subject receives the damage and is additionally dazed for 1d4+1 rounds.

name: Vermilion Stars
description: You release a swarm of energy-charged missiles that deals 1d4 points of damage per caster level (maximum 25d4) to each target within the range around the caster, reflex save for half damage. Half of the damage is electricity, half is bleeding (certain enemies will be immune).<br/>Dealing enough damage might bring forth wrath of forlon beings, cursing the prey, which has a chance to petrify targets for 1d4+1 rounds (Fortitude Negates).<br/>Special: This spell belongs to [[:Category:Blood Arcana|Blood Arcana]], as such to cast it a portion of own health needs to be sacrificed as part of the material component.

name: CRIMSON LIGHTNING
description: You release a tangle of razor-sharp briars of electrical energy that deals 1d6 points of damage per caster level (maximum 15d6) to the targets within the area. If the main target dies from this spell the briars explode wounding everyone in the area and dealing 1d3 points of damage per caster level (maximum 15d3) and applies a minor curse (-2 Att) (Fortitude negates both the curse and damage). The secondary effect is not affected by metamagic. Half of the damage is Electricity, and half is Bleeding (certain enemies will be immune). Special: This spell belongs to Blood Arcana, as such to cast it a portion of own health needs to be sacrificed as part of the material component.

name: BESTOW WOUND
description: The caster drains the subject dealing d3 points of bleeding damage for every 3 caster levels. Healing self for 1 point for every 3 caster levels. Empowered if the target is frightened.

name: HEMORRHAGE
description: The target must have blood. The caster weaves a vulnerability curse at the target. The curse causes a burst of bleeding damage and decreases resistance to damage. The caster causes 3d6 + 1d6 / per 3 caster levels (max 10d6) points of damage. This is further (damage dice and DC) increased: by 1 if the target is: lightly wounded (80%-50% HP); by 2 if the target is heavily wounded (50%-25% HP); by 3 if the target is near death (below 25% HP). Half of the damage is negative, half is bleeding type. Fortitude saves halves the damage received and neglects the curse. (The curse is tagged, multiple applications and sources do not stack). Curse of Hemorrhage: vulnerability to slashing, piercing, and bleeding 10%. Increases by 5% if the caster has Epic Spell Focus (Necromancy). Increases by 5% if the caster is Wizard Necromancy Specialist, Pale Master, Hemomancer, Warlock(Undying II), Cleric with Death or Undeath domain.

name: SOUL SCOUR
description: Does 1d4 points of wisdom and charisma damage every 4 caster levels. If the wisdom or charisma would drop below 3, the target is stunned instead for 1 round/level. If subject of the spell is a divine spellcaster (Cleric, Druid, Shaman, Paladin, Fav Soul, Ranger) the DC of the spell rises by 4.

name: GRIM TERROR
description: The caster outcries forth a nightmare curse. The caster causes 4d6 + 1d6 / per 4 caster levels (max 15d6) points of psychic damage and frightens everyone within the area. Will save: half the damage received and neglects the fear effect. (Creatures with mind effect immunity take no damage). The DC is increased by 2 if the caster is below 50% HP. Base Size: Huge (6.67 meters radius). Size increases by 1 category if the caster has Epic Spell Focus (Necromancy). Furthermore size increases by 1 category if the caster is Wizard Necromancy Specialist, Pale Master, Hemomancer, Warlock(Undying II), Cleric with Death or Undeath domain.

name: Predator
description: The caster takes the aspect of the relentless hunter. For the duration of the effect the caster gains: Movement Speed Increase: 30%, Immunity to Movement Speed Decrease, Concealment: 20%. SF Necromancy increases Concealment by 5%, and Speed by 5%. GSF Necromancy increases Concealment by another 5%, Speed by another 5%, and extends the duration to 3 rounds per CL. ESF Necromancy further increases Speed by 10%. This effect is breachable. Removes Movement Speed Penalties (but no other movement-inhibiting effects such as [[Slow]]) when applied.
